text: Stormheim is the easternmost region of the Broken Isles archipelago, situated in the shadow of Highmountain to the west and the ancient region of Suramar to the southwest. Stormheim is notably home to a large population of vrykul who left Northrend many ages ago in search of their holy land. The region's rugged, uneven landscape has since become something of a cradle for vrykul society, which is centered around its long fjords and steep ravines. Religion and culture in Stormheim generally revolves around the titan keeper Odyn, who is viewed as a god among the vrykul, though his nemesis Helya is also venerated in some areas. In recent times, vrykul belonging to the Tideskorn clan have also pl
Stormkeeper is an Elemental shaman ability, learned from The Fist of Ra-den.

Stormsong Valley is the northernmost region of Kul Tiras, bordered by the Tiragarde Sound region to the south. This valley is the home to House Stormsong and is the breadbasket of Kul Tiras. These verdant highlands and foothills provide Kul Tiras with food as well as ship production. The Stormsong builds and blesses all Kul Tiran vessels, and Tidesages from Sagehold board the largest ones for guidance at sea. Lumber comes in from the forests north of Tiragarde Sound, and it gets floated down the Twin Rivers to Mariner's Strand, the Kul Tiras's hub of ship production. There are a number of businesses devoted to ship production on the island, most notably the Brineworks and Addington Shipyards

Stormforged Valarjar are vrykul who have been transformed for their valor and heroism by the keeper Odyn, granting them new metallic forms and increased strength. These warriors make Skyhold their home, and are loyal to Odyn himself, and his chosen Battlelord. Apart from celebrating in the Great Mead Hall in Skyhold, the Stormforged undertake missions in Odyn's name. With the third invasion of Azeroth by the Burning Legion, the Odyn has committed the Valarjar to fighting the demons alongside the other Class Orders. Since then, the Stormforged have taken part in numerous engagements, including a raid on Niskara, the Assault on Broken Shore, and the Argus Campaign.

Stormpike Commandos are dwarves that spawn when you hand in either 70 Coldtooth Supplies or 280 Irondeep Supplies. One need to be or higher with the Stormpike Guard to launch the assault. The commandos will run to Field of Strife killing everything in their way. Once they have reached the middle of the Field they will spawn Field Marshal Teravaine which is a powerful semi boss. These mobs scale off how many Armor Scraps your team has handed in to Murgot Deepforge: *If your team has handed in 500 Armor Scraps these mobs will spawn as Seasoned Commandos. *If your team has handed in 1000 Armor Scraps these mobs will spawn as Veteran Commandos. *If your team has handed in 1500 Armor Scraps these
__NOTOC__ Stormpeak Hatchlings are proto dragon whelps located in the mountains surrounding Brunnhildar Village in the Storm Peaks.
Stormkeeper's Power is an Elemental shaman artifact trait. It is not linked to any other traits and requires all other base traits to be learned.

__NOTOC__ Stormhide Calves are thunder lizards located in Redrock Mesa and Redrock Cavern in Vol'dun. Some are deceased, but during A Jolt of Power, Akunda asks adventurers to rescue calves that have been poisoned by the ranishu and are clinging to life.
Stormscreech is a wind serpent located in Island Expeditions.
Stormstout's Last Keg is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Stormstout.

Stormpike is the name of the Stormpike Clan, and their expeditionary force, the Stormpike Guard, which is the Alliance faction in Alterac Valley. The name can also refer to: NPCs *Vanndar Stormpike *Stormpike Emissary *Muren Stormpike *Mountaineer Stormpike *Sergeant Durgen Stormpike *Tamra Stormpike *Prospector Stormpike *Stormpike Owl *Corporal Noreg Stormpike Quests *Stormpike's Delivery *Stormpike's Order Items *Stormpike Insignia *Stormpike Battle Charger *Stormpike Leather Girdle *Stormpike Soldier's Cloak *Stormpike Plate Girdle Locations *The Stormpike Graveyard and Stormpike Aid Station, key strategic targets in Alterac Valley

Stormwind Stockade, aka The Stockade, is a heavily guarded prison in the middle of Stormwind City. A large number of dangerous criminals, including some criminal masterminds and Defias mercenaries, are currently being held in the stockade. However, not so long ago, there was a revolt inside the dungeon, and the prisoners now keep the Stockade under their control. Recommended group composition is a competent and reasonably balanced group of players around level 27, with a decent level 27, at least, tank or very competent players for the final mini-boss.
__NOTOC__ Stormwind Seasoning Herbs can be purchased from Felicia Gump in the Fragrant Flowers flower shop in Stormwind City. They no longer have any use in retail World of Warcraft.

Stormwind Guards are human guards located at various locations throughout Elwynn Forest. They can be found patrolling the roads, stationed in Goldshire, Westbrook Garrison, near Guard Thomas, and at Ridgepoint Tower. They are flagged for PvP and will attack any member of the Horde on sight. They can provide directions to various locations in Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City. They are found in the Vision of Stormwind.

__NOTOC__ Strahad Farsan is a human warlock trainer located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. When he was facing down his felhunter, he barely escaped with his life, but eventually he became a powerful warlock teaching greater summoning. He is part of Gakin the Darkbinder's inner circle. The tower belongs to him. Acolyte Magaz, Acolyte Fenrick, and Acolyte Wytula are his acolytes.
Stormy Azure Moonstone is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Lustrous Star of Elune is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Strange Snowman is a snowman located outside Growless Cave in the Alterac Mountains.

A Stormwind Gift Collection is a collection of the three Stormwind City pledge item packages, and is the second hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Stormwind NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. __NOTOC__
Stormwind Assassin's Guild (or the Stormwind Assassins' Guild and simply the Assassins' Guild) is a group of assassins operating in Stormwind City.
The Stormwind University is a university in Stormwind City. Quentin Bandor was a student of architecture there.

The Stormwind Army (or the Stormwind Marshals) is one of the principal military wings of the armed forces of the human Kingdom of Stormwind. Along with the forces in the Alliance navy, Stormwind's army constitutes one of its main contributions to the military of the Grand Alliance, of which the kingdom is central. The army has been an integral part of Stormwind's survival throughout the many events following its reconstruction after the Second War. Naturally based from Stormwind City, the army has been deployed to a great many areas across Azeroth and beyond. Close to home in the Eastern Kingdoms, the Stormwind Army sees active duty in regions such as Elwynn Forest, Westfall, Duskwood, the R

.]] Stormwind Harbor is a large port and shipyard, consisting of a series of wharfs, dry docks, and fortifications located in the northwestern area of Stormwind City, with the access point set between the Park and Cathedral Square districts. The harbor serves as a major strategic base for both the Kingdom of Stormwind and the Alliance navy. Here, many Alliance warships are constructed and fleets assembled; it is likely the largest and most important Alliance naval base in the Great Sea and potentially beyond. From a civilian perspective, transport ships regularly sail from the harbor to numerous other destinations across Azeroth, such as Rut'theran Village in Kalimdor, and Valiance Keep in N

Strange Tarot is an Inscription spell that creates one of four 'Swords' cards at random: * Ace of Swords, Two of Swords, Three of Swords or Four of Swords. Combining one of each card creates a , which begins Darkmoon Faire quest Swords Deck (quest).

This tabard can be purchased for from in the Trade District of Stormwind City at reputation with Stormwind. It can also still be purchased from , but the cost and the requirement make him obsolete as a source for this tabard.
Stormwind Harbor Guards are human city guards that watch over and protect the Stormwind Harbor.

Stormwind Visitor's Center is a visitor center located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. Here you can create your own guild by talking to Stormwind's Guild Master Aldwin Laughlin. Once you've created your guild, you can design your very own Guild Tabard by talking to Rebecca Laughlin. After the Cataclysm, the building got interior changes and no longer has an upper floor.

Stormwind Counting House is a bank found in the Trade District of Stormwind City. In Patch 4.0.3a, the interior was redesigned and then copied to make the Royal Bank of Stormwind in the Dwarven District. The Westmill family and Kristin Cazarez were also added.

The Stormwind City Outskirts is a small rural area outside the walls of Stormwind, accessable from the Dwarven District. There is a pond and a small farmhouse located in this area. After the ending of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, a new embassy was constructed in the outskirts.
Stormwind Satchel is a reputation reward; you must be with Stormwind to purchase it from in Stormwind City for .

Stormwind Elites form the fighting elite in Stormwind's majesty's service. They could be found accompanying King Varian Wrynn during The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance). They were are also found as guards in Stormwind Harbor during the Scourge invasion event.
This map contains many of the points of interest within the city of Stormwind.
Stormwind Rats can be found throughout Stormwind City and in parts of Elwynn Forest.
The Stormwind Citizens were humans located in Stormwind City and Elwynn Forest encountered during various quests, commenting on the events. They were being recruited for the Twilight's Hammer.
Stormwind Harbor Archers were guards present in Stormwind City during the Scourge attack world event immediately preceding the release of Wrath of the Lich King.
Stormwind Fishermen are humans found fishing at various places around Stormwind City.

Strange Spore is found at on top of a mushroom in northeastern Umbrafen in northeastern . To get to the top of the mushroom, start at Exarch's Rise, the high point above Elodor, where the capstone quest in "The Pursuit of Justice" chapter of the Shadowmoon Valley storyline played out. From the rise at look north and down to the pool of water and get down there. From the rock outcrop at at the northwestern end of the pool, look uphill to the northwest to find a similarly-sized rock outcrop two ledges up. On the ledge at where that outcrop is (don't bother trying to get on top of that rock!), follow the ledge to the southwest until it ends at overlooking the Umbrafen. Carefully jump down two l
Stormwind Sailors are humans found at Shattershore in the Blasted Lands, who are serving in the Alliance navy. They are taking part of the offensive against the Iron Horde forces in the region.
Stormwind Dock Workers are humans located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. They can be found throughout the harbor doing various work such as moving materials or working on siege weapons.
Stormwind Lobster Trap is a cage trap for lobsters, which can be found in the waters of the Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Stormwind Orphans are human children located in the orphanage, in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. For many of them, their parents have been killed as a result of ongoing conflicts throughout Azeroth. They are raised and taken care of by the orphanage's stewards, Orphan Matron Nightingale and Shellene. In the Vision of Stormwind, they can be found running about the area near the orphanage. Five of them are gathered behind the building, standing in a pentagram shape around the corpse of Orphan Matron Nightingale. Here they chant while they throw skulls to each other for sport.

__NOTOC__ Stormwind Knights are troops from Stormwind City following Varian Wrynn during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance). Despite being knights, they look and fight just like footmen. After the battle, some of them are found wounded aboard the Skyfire, being treated by Stormwind Priests and Gilnean Druids.

Stormwind Priests are troops from Stormwind City following Varian Wrynn on the Broken Shore during the Battle for Broken Shore. Some of them can be seen on the Skyfire afterwards, healing the wounded from the battle. Due to their robes, they are presumably members of the Church of the Holy Light. One appears in the Sanctum of Light.

Stormwind Gryphons are dead gryphons from Stormwind City during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance). They are presumably the mounts of the Stormwind Gryphon Riders accompanying the third fleet to the Broken Shore. More Stormwind Gryphons appeared in Westfall, being injured by demons during the Legion Invasions. They could be rescued by the Alliance and Horde adventurers.
Stormwind Mages were human mages of Stormwind City fighting against the Burning Legion during the Legion Invasions in Westfall.

The Stormwind Embassy is a building in Stormwind City that serves as a meeting point for the leadership of the Alliance and as headquarters for its allied races. It was established following the defeat of the Burning Legion in the Argus Campaign, and can be found on Stormwind's northern outskirts, near the Wollerton Stead. , with the leaders of the Alliance gathered.]] Much of the Alliance's efforts in the lead up to the Fourth War, notably involving the recruitment of new allied races, was based from this location, although most of the Alliance leaders left mid-way through the Fourth War, and Aysa Cloudsinger assisted with recruitment efforts in their stead. A forge and a mining trainer can
Stormwind Medics are located at the infirmary in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City treating Wounded Soldiers. They also partake in the Battle for Lordaeron.
Stormwind Infantry Captains are human infantry captains of the Stormwind Army located in Stormwind City.
The Strange Seed is located at the portal in Stormwind City (on the Elwynn Forest map) to the Everbloom as part of the It's a Waist of Time secret.
Stranded Cache is located on top of a large cliff just south of Redsilt Wash in northwestern Vol'dun. Without flying, it is only reachable by climbing a dead tree leaning against the cliff.
Stormwind Firebreathers were humans located in Stormwind City. They were replaced by Master Fire Eaters.
Strange Oceanic Sediments drop primarily from algan in Nazjatar. This item is used for summoning elementals in Mardivas's Laboratory.
The Stormwind Entertainer is a human found patrolling the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. She will shoot out Free T-Shirts in the streets with her special shirt gun.
Stormwind Battlemagi are humans located in Stormwind City during The Stormwind Extraction.
The Stout Mountain Horse is a horse located in Gilneas. It is provided by Lord Hewell.
Strange Clockwork Gladius drops from: *Overseer Stonetongue *Overloading Defense Matrix *Phenran *Ancient Protector *Spellforged Destroyer *Arkhuu *Disoriented Watcher
Strashaz Hydras are hydras that inhabit the waters around Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Stretched Leather Trousers are leather pants that gives a small bonus to strength and agility.
Strength of the Clefthoof is a leather rare crafted set from The Burning Crusade. It is crafted by Leatherworking.
A buff gained through the World PvP struggle for the city of Halaa. This is a zone-wide buff given to all players in Nagrand for the faction holding Halaa.
Bonuses for Strength can only be obtained through Red gems, Orange gems and Purple gems.

__NOTOC__ Stromgarde Defenders are humans found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. Undead Stromgarde Defenders serving Prince Galen are located throughout the city during the The Ruined Kingdom questline. They are initially friendly, but turn hostile after Galen betrays the player following the completion of Death... and Decay and Our Oldest Enemies. The living Stromgarde Defenders appear in the Alliance-retaken Stromgarde Keep as well as during the Battle for Stromgarde fighting against the Horde.
The Strashaz naga were located on the Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. They employed their own breed of hydras, as well as the couatl.
Strength of Isha Awak is a buff rewarded from Isha Awak (quest).
The Strength of the Heavens can be looted from the Gift of the Observer after defeating Algalon the Observer in the 10-man version of Ulduar.
Strashaz Myrmidons are naga located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Strashaz Warriors are naga located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Strashaz Serpent Guards are naga located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.

Strife and Peril are literary mistlurkers found in Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. They've been brought to life by the destruction of the Corrupted Scroll that contained "The Trial of the Yaungol". The legend says when Osong traveled to Kun'lai plains, he encountered the two of them. As more the yaungol attacked them, the more powerful they became, when he left them alone, it shrank to nothingness.
Strength and Honor is a professions achievement requiring the discovery of all Draenor Clan archaeology relics.
Strike of the Windlord is a Windwalker monk ability, learned from Fists of the Heavens.
Strashaz Sirens are naga located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Strashaz Sorceresses were naga located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
The Strangely Seasoned Meat drops from mobs on Mechagon Island.
The Strength of the Nazjatar is a quest reward from Legion world quests or can be obtained from caches.
Streaking Stars is an Azerite trait available to Balance druids.
String of Fangs and Talons is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Strength of Earth is an Azerite trait available to Enhancement shaman.<!--

Strike with Clarity is a conduit for monks in the Kyrian covenant. It drops from the following bosses: *Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond.
Stratholme Child Specimens are humans located outside the Culling of Stratholme in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Stratholme Resident Specimens are humans located outside the Culling of Stratholme in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Stratholme Citizen Specimens are humans located outside the Culling of Stratholme in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Strigidium is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned for Kyrian Covenant-aligned players.
Stroke of Elegance is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Strength to Weakness is a potential daily quest at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.
Strengthened Abomination Hook drops from Collector Kash in Maldraxxus.
Strength in Adversity is a Protection paladin talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Crusader's Resolve.
Strength of the Treant is a quest reward from Weapons of Spirit.
__NOTOC__ Strong Troll's Blood Elixir helps increase your health regeneration rate.
Stronghold Gauntlets are a powerful set of plate gloves that not only improve chances to parry and critically hit, but also reduce disarm duration.

A stun lock (also called stunlocking) is the act of using multiple stuns and immobilizing effects in succession to prevent an enemy from fighting back or escaping. As a result, a stunlock sacrifices a large amount of DPS in exchange for keeping the opponent "locked down", but that doesn't matter because it is extremely annoying and in the act of stunlocking provides other players to freely attack the enemy as he stands there unable to do anything. Although typically and most easily accomplished by a rogue, it can also be achieved to lesser degrees by warriors, paladins and druids. Some refer to this ability as a full kill of an enemy player in PvP without allowing them to react, whereas othe

Student of the Mind is a Mage talent in the Arcane tree. It increases your total Spirit stat by up to 10% at maximum rank. The spirit upgrade into the mages stats allows more mana regeneration, but only outside the five-second rule. While pretty useless on its own, if used with Molten Armor, it will turn into DPS increase.
Studious Chu is a pandaren flight master located at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Stun Seed is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

There are four Sturdy Chests on the Timeless Isle: *Huojin rise *Tushui rise *Croaking Hollow *Mysterious Den The two chests on the rises on the western side of the island require the use of a Highwind Albatross. See the albatross's article for information on catching them. The chest at Croaking Hollow is out in the open, but guarded by a few Gulp Frogs. The chest in the Mysterious Den requires accessing the den, so see the mysterious den's article for information. Each chest may only be opened once per character, and contains a few hundred Timeless Coins and one or two Timeless armor tokens.
This city is controlled by a pack of bandits and wizards. Entering it at night could be fatal if you don't keep your eyes open.
__NOTOC__ Stygia is a black dragon that can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Strongbox Key drops from Knuckles in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. It is used to open Bondo's Strongbox.
Stygian Guise drops from Maut in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Stunning Peck is an ability used by a seagull during a Pet Battle.

Among the most favored of the flamewakers, Sulfuron Harbinger is the terrifying herald of Ragnaros himself. From the infernal depths of the Molten Core, the Harbinger commands Ambassador Flamelash and the other lesser flamewakers in the outside world. Sulfuron Harbinger answers only to Executus and guards the rune of Koro, one of several runes that empower the Firelord's servants. Sulfuron Harbinger keeps Shazzrah in particular under close watch, believing that Shazzrah seeks to betray Ragnaros. Flanked by four of the Firelord's most fervid priests, the Harbinger prepares for the day when the elemental lord of fire claims the world of Azeroth for his own. Sulfuron Harbinger is a Flamewaker b

Sulfuron Keep is the fortress-sanctum of Ragnaros, located deep within the Firelands. After his defeat in the Molten Core of Blackrock Mountain, Ragnaros was banished back to the Elemental Plane, but re-emerged at Mount Hyjal during the Cataclysm to burn the World Tree Nordrassil to ash. The Guardians of Hyjal, aided by mortal heroes, forced him back into the Firelands, where they must venture for their final confrontation with the Firelord. The way into the keep is blocked until the defeat of Ragnaros' champions on the "mainland" of the Firelands, ending with Baleroc the Gatekeeper, who controls the bridge across the fiery "moat" that bars the way.

Suffering is an ability of the Voidwalker, a warlock minion. It acts as a taunt, forcing the target to attack the Voidwalker for 5 seconds, and significantly increases its threat generated during the effect.
Styleen's Impeding Scarab is a trinket used by tanks to increase their capacity to block effectively, as well as buff their general defenses.
Stylish Black Shirt is a shirt item that can be purchased for from in Stormwind City. It can also be obtained from Free T-Shirts in Orgrimmar or Stormwind during Free T-Shirt Day.

The Succubus is the female variant of the Sayaad, the third demonic minion available to the warlock, summoned through the Summon Sayaad ability. The male counterpart is the Incubus. The two are functionally identical in terms of gameplay, with the only differences being cosmetic. By default, Summon Sayaad summons either an Incubus or Succubus at random, but warlocks can speak with Laphandrus Voidheart/ Kazak Darkscream to obtain a Barbed Collar of the Succubus that changes the spell to Summon Succubus, ensuring that only that gender is summoned.
Subtle Lionseye is crafted with Outland Jewelcrafting (75); taught by Design: Subtle Lionseye and Design: Subtle Lionseye#Shattered Sun Offensive.
Styleen's Sour Suckerpop can be purchased for from: * in Orgrimmar * in Stormwind City * in Ironforge * in Orgrimmar

__NOTOC__ Subjugator Devo is a member of Overlord Krom'gar's army stationed at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains. Realizing that the Alliance and Grimtotem partnership might push the scales in the Alliance's favor, Devo decides to recruit the local kobolds in the region. After instructing the adventurer to whip them into servitude, he instructs the adventurer to unleash the kobolds upon an Alliance regiment. To Devo's joy the kobolds successfully beat back the Alliance.

The Sugarpack Bakery was a bakery on Kezan known for its cookies, which, according to Jastor Gallywix, were the best. The bakery was destroyed after being bombed during Trade War II, bombed once again during Trade War IV, and finally melted during the Peace War.
__NOTOC__ Subdued Kobolds are kobolds located at Stonetalon Mountains, they were formerly members of the Boulderslide group.
Subjugator Devo's Whip is provided by Subjugator Devo to use on any kobold inside Boulderslide Cavern in the Stonetalon Mountains for Reinforcements...
Sulfuras Smash is an ability used by Lil' Ragnaros during a Pet Battle.
The Subjugated Inferno Lord is a dead Twilight Inferno Lord located in Mount Hyjal. He was briefly revived by pouring a Bottled Bileberry Brew in his mouth.
__NOTOC__ Sul the Sandcrawler is a powerful sand troll, skilled at manipulating the sand.

Subjugator Vuur is a nathrezim that appeared at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh where he mind controlled the local Dun Morogh Mountaineers, and they had to be beaten up in order to make him vulnerable. He also appeared at the Sludge Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills as well as in Dalaran.
Subjugated Souls are orc souls located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
The Suction Tube drops from Scrapbone Fishermen located at the lake in the Fleeting Forest on Mechagon Island.
Sucker Punch is an expansion feature achievement earned by killing a player that is affected by a Sticky Starfish during an Island Expedition.

Subjugator Klontzas is a mawsworn located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Defeating this creature will leave behind an Anima Cell with the choice between the Vial of Lost Potential and Subjugator's Manacles Anima powers.
Subjugator's Manacles is an anima power obtained from the Anima Cell left behind after defeating Subjugator Klontzas in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sulhasa was a tauren flight master found at Valor's Rest in Silithus prior to patch 1.8.
Suffused Azerite is an Azerite elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Succulent Carpaccio is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Suffused Noble Writ is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Subjugator Zeltoth is a Maw caster located at the Immortal Hearth in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.

__NOTOC__ The Submerged Chest is found in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis. While initially out of reach, the Forgotten Pump can be activated with the Dangerous Orb of Power in order to pull the chest up to the surface.
Su'esh's Lair is a the home of Su'esh. It is a cave located in the Menagerie in Suramar City.

The Sullied Banner is a rogue mage sect led by Turi Flickerflame, a former apprentice of the late Archmage Rhonin, that wanted to create mana bombs on Theramore Isle to protect themselves from their enemies. After the discovery of the Dragon Isles, the blue dragonflight peacefully intervened under the order of Kalecgos to stop their activities.

Sudsy Magee is a charlatan originally found in Kezan who now resides in Bilgewater Harbor, Azshara. During the goblin starting experience, Sudsy is one of the deadbeats the player must rough up in order to make them pay their debts. He appears to be a mage based on this encounter. At some point he escaped with the other refugees to Azshara. He can be found on the coast surrounded by admirers, painting an Imported Mottled Boar—though the painting appears to be of a sheep. If a player kills the boar, the admirers will sometimes burst into tears, and Sudsy will run over briefly and attempt to console them. Summon Voidwalker is a warlock ability that allows the summoning of a Voidwalker minion.

The Sun Gate is a portal located near the Vector Coil in Bloodmyst Isle. It was opened by the Sunhawks, servitors of Sun King Kael'thas Sunstrider, in order to allow blood elf reinforcements from the fortress of Tempest Keep to enter the Azuremyst Isles, with the intent of retaking the Exodar. The portal, which didn't seem to close, showed the front of Tempest Keep. Draenei adventurers were called upon to destabilize and destroy it, sealing off the entry point for Kael'thas' elves to enter Azeroth.
Summon Felhunter is a warlock ability that summons a Felhunter to serve as the warlock's minion.

The Summoners' Tomb is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is accessible from the Mold Foundry. It leads on to the Lyceum and the Molten Bridge. It is populated by the seven ghostly dwarves, the patriarchs of the Dark Iron nation - and the dwarves who helped Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan summon Ragnaros into the world. These dwarves must be killed to pass on to the later areas, but before the attack, any miners in the group should speak with and do his quest to gain the ability to smelt Dark Iron Ore. A paladin mentioned in a short story is said to be a sun paladin. A sun paladin is apparently a type of paladin taken up by some humans of the Alliance. They are capable of harnessing the power of the sun in their weapons and auras. This particular Alliance sun paladin in the story was helping a Horde plagueshifter fight some deep elementals in the Eastern Plaguelands. He used a crossbow at first and then switched to a sword. It is unclear with what faction most sun paladins are affiliated. It is possible that some are aligned with the Alliance — some favoring the Argent Dawn and others the Scarlet Crusade.

Sun's Reach is town and the staging area for the Shattered Sun Offensive on the Isle of Quel'Danas. Their forces must battle against the army of Kael'thas Sunstrider, including the Dawnblade blood elves, the wretched, and demons of the Burning Legion.

.]] Sun's Reach Harbor is the harbor of the Sun's Reach town and it is the initial entry point for adventurers entering the Isle of Quel'Danas. After Sun's Reach is captured, the main building becomes the island's inn. The harbor itself houses boats upon which battle continues.

The Sun's Reach Sanctum is an arcane sanctum found in the town of Sun's Reach on the Isle of Quel'Danas. It is located south of the Sun's Reach Harbor and the Shattered Sun Staging Area, and is on the north side of the Dawning Square with the Sun's Reach Armory.

It requires a minimum skill of 450 and a Simple Grinder. ; Materials required: :1x Eye of Zul The recipe taught by Design: Sundered Eye of Zul, sold by Timothy Jones in Dalaran, and Inessera in Shattrath City for 4 Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.
Sun Bleached Bracer is a quest reward from Rite of Strength.

Summon Great Sunwalker Kodo is an epic version of the Sunwalker Kodo mount only available to Tauren Paladins at level 40 with the Journeyman Riding skill and the Summon Sunwalker Kodo ability learned.
Summoner Calwen is a warlock trainer located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary in the mage city of Dalaran.
Summoner Durael is a blood elf warlock trainer of the Scryers located in the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

Summon Great Exarch's Elekk is an epic version of the Exarch's Elekk mount. It is available to draenei and Lightforged draenei paladins at level 40 with the Journeyman Riding skill and their respective apprentice mount ability learned.

Summon Observer was a warlock ability. It was unlocked by the Glyph of the Observer and replaced Summon Felhunter. Unlike other summons that were merged with their base counterparts in patch 10.1.5 as part of a customization update, Observers were completely removed. The reason given was that they were too different from their origin summon (felhunters).
Summon Abyssal is a warlock ability unlocked by the level 75 talent Grimoire of Supremacy (original warlock talent). It replaces Summon Infernal.
Summon Terrorguard is a warlock ability unlocked by the level 75 talent Grimoire of Supremacy (original warlock talent). It replaces Summon Doomguard.
Summon White Tiger Statue is a Windwalker monk ability, available at level 70.

Summon Friend is an ability only available through the Recruit-A-Friend program. It allows one of a pair of characters on accounts linked through RAF to summon the other to their location. This spell does not appear in the spellbook and cannot be placed on action bars. Instead, it is triggered by right-clicking the target's party portrait or entry in the Friends List and selecting "Summon Friend".

__NOTOC__ Sundersong Glade (or Shal'doren Grove) is a small druidic outpost situated deep in the forests of Val'sharah. A small cave full of crazed owlbeasts lies in the southern part of the glade. The same road that takes you to this area continues all the way to Highmountain.

Sumber the Drowned is a water elemental located in Vol'dun. According to Water Reclamation, it is very powerful.

This highway went on to the northeast at some point, probably before the Great Sundering. The area has many titanic relics. During the Faction Assaults, the area was taken by the Alliance coming from the Sunken Coast and turning it into a battlefield between the Horde. The Horde destroyed the Alliance army with Pozzik's Experimental Bomber upgraded with :Azerite. Summon Steward is an ability unlocked for members of the Kyrian Covenant. A different steward companion can be selected in Your Next Best Friend.
The Summoned Mountainbuck is a stag located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos. It appears through a portal and Stablehand Ta'shno will stable it in the Dimensional Storage Cube.

The Sunspire is a large blood elven tower on Sunstrider Isle surrounded by levitating satellite buildings. It is the first area where newly emerged blood elf adventurers will find quests before they move deeper into Quel'Thalas. It contains class trainers, excluding Death knights. After finishing quests upon Sunstrider Isle, adventurers will be guided by Lanthan Perilon to Outrunner Alarion, and then to the Ruins of Silvermoon.

A location somewhere on Azeroth. A great civilization once inhabited the islands of this sunny archipelago. Now its shipyards are overrun with mur'gul, and other even more precious sources are guarded by a massive dragon turtle and her offspring.

The army consisted mostly of blood elves, but also included some fel orcs and demons making their numbers into thousands. Some pilgrims from Quel'Thalas also voluntarily joined their group. The bulk of their army had been established both in the Netherstorm and Shadowmoon Valley, while several of their members left the main contingent to follow other pursuits; mainly, the Scryers and the blood elven forces loyal to Illidan Stormrage. It is controlled by the Sunreavers, a group of blood elves under the Archmage's command. The Sanctuary houses an inn, an auctioneer, and several vendors as well as the Wintergrasp battle-mage, Magister Surdiel, and a portal to Orgrimmar. After Jaina Proudmoore discovered that the Sunreavers helped Garrosh Hellscream steal the Divine Bell by using Dalaran portals to infiltrate Darnassus, Jaina mobilized the Kirin Tor, Alliance forces, and the Silver Covenant to purge the Horde from Dalaran, including Sunreaver's Sanctuary. __NOTOC__ Sunfury Blood Lords are blood elves found at the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Sunken Dig Site is the flooded remains of the silithid-infested Rustmaul Dig Site in the southern Thousand Needles. When the region was flooded, most of the silithid seem to have burrowed underground (although the wasps now instead fly about above the water's surface). The gnome Brivelthwerp wanted to turn the now seemingly empty hive into a refrigeration vault for his ice cream empire. However, when the pipes had almost been installed, the silithid burrowed out of the cave and killed all of his employees. Brivelthwerp himself survived on his tugboat on the surface, where he asks adventurers for help in salvaging the operation. __NOTOC__
Sunlight is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Frosthands are blood elven magi encountered in the Underbelly in Dalaran during the Purge of Dalaran. They specialize in frost magic. Notably, they (like the Sunreaver Captains) have blue eyes.

The Sunreaver Onslaught is the Horde reputation faction introduced in patch 5.2. It is personally led by Lor'themar Theron, Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas, and bears the namesake of the Sunreavers. Its base camp is named the Dawnseeker Promontory. Their main goals are to prevent the Kirin Tor Offensive, allied to the Alliance, from obtaining powerful artifacts from Emperor Lei Shen and to also fight the coalition of Zandalari and mogu threatening Pandaria. Daily quests for the Sunreaver Onslaught are divided into two categories, only one of which can be chosen per day: PvE-oriented tasks, or PvP-based missions. The former involves assisting Grand Magister Rommath, Halduron Brightwing and Aethas

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Magi are blood elves found on the Isle of Thunder. They appear in various stages of the isle, and in various locations, among them Dawnseeker Promontory and its surrounding terrain, and aboard the triad of blood elven destroyers. In the early stages of the promontory's construction, they have some amusing gossip text and dialogue, with some throwbacks to the blood elves' predicaments during the The Burning Crusade era.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Rangers are blood elf rangers found on the Isle of Thunder. They perform various roles during their stay on the isle, such as undertaking scouting missions for Halduron Brightwing and serving as bodyguards to the regent lord. They are Farstriders operating under the banner of the Sunreaver Onslaught. They briefly appear during To the Skies! (Horde).
The Sunreaver Magister is a blood elf found on the Isle of Thunder. He will appear after Horde forces take over the Lightning Vein Mine, and empower the portal back to Dawnseeker Promontory.

Surwich is a Gilnean fishing village and port located to the southwest of the Blasted Lands. Upon their arrival, Wormthorn believed that the Tainted Scar could be healed, and attempted to grow it back by creating the great tree Maldraz with his power.
